duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset) in seconds

sample.Description: Onset of the event according to the sampling scheme of the recorded modality

trial_type.Description: Primary categorisation of each trial to identify them as instances of the experimental conditions.

stim_file.Description: Represents the location of the stimulus file (image, video, sound etc.) presented at the given onset time.

onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event measured from the beginning of the acquisition of the first volume in the corresponding task imaging data file

value.Description: Marker value associated with the event

Task.LongName: Loudness Dependence of Auditory Evoked Potential (LDAEP)
Task.Description: During the LDAEP paradigm, the participants were seated in a dimly lit and sound-attenuating room. Participants have presented a series of auditory tones at 1000 Hz with the loudness intensities of 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 dB binaurally through inserted earphones (ER3C Insert Earphones, Etymotic Research Inc., USA) using E-prime 2.0 software (Pittsburgh, PA). Each stimulus (30 ms duration including 10ms rise and fall) was presented 80 times in a pseudorandomized order with an interstimulus interval randomized between 1200 and 1800 ms.
